methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages fetched and verified directly on 2026-06-18: spacelift.io/pricing, env0.com/pricing (plus env0's docs domain docs.envzero.com/guides/billing/subscription-tiers, which is the live redirect target of docs.env0.com), scalr.com/pricing, docs.scalr.io/docs/pricing-faq, AWS Marketplace listing prodview-6mlcdsurh25r2 (Scalr Annual Business Subscription), terrateam.io/pricing, terramate.io/pricing, and hashicorp.com/products/terraform/pricing. Compliance verified against each vendor's OWN security/trust page; third-party aggregator profiles (e.g. nudgesecurity.com) were NOT treated as vendor claims. Key corrections vs. draft: (1) Spacelift's own security page claims only SOC 2 Type II and FedRAMP — HIPAA and GDPR are NOT vendor-claimed, so set null. (2) Scalr's current pricing page shows the free tier is named 'Business' (50 runs/mo) plus an Enterprise custom tier; the draft's separate paid 'Business' at $99/mo for 100 prepaid runs is NOT on the current page (outdated/removed) and was dropped; the free tier was renamed to its real name 'Business'. Scalr's public compliance announcement is SOC 2 Type I (the 'soc-2-type-2-achieved' URL redirects to trust.scalr.io and the standing announcement is Type I), so the Type II claim was downgraded. (3) HCP Terraform per-resource rates ($0.10/$0.47/$0.99 per resource/mo) and 500-resource PAYG free allowance verified; legacy free plan EOL was March 31, 2026. (4) Digger rebranded to OpenTaco on 2025-11-07; community edition is MIT-licensed; digger.dev/pricing returns 404 and there is no public commercial price, so the old unverified $3,000-$5,000/mo note was removed. accessedAt 2026-06-18.

vendors.name: Spacelift
vendors.provenance: Fetched spacelift.io/pricing on 2026-06-18. Compliance taken from spacelift.io/security, which explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II and FedRAMP only. HIPAA and GDPR are NOT claimed on the vendor's own security page (they appear only on a third-party Nudge Security profile), so they are set null.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 2 users, 1 public shared worker, no credit card required, no time limit. Full platform access with limits.

plans.name: Starter+
plans.notes: Billed annually at $20,000/year (=$1,667/mo equivalent). Unlimited users, 2 public workers + 1-2 private workers. Annual subscription only.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Custom quote. Unlimited users, 3 private workers. Annual subscription.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom quote. Unlimited users, 5-30 private workers. Annual subscription.

plans.name: Enterprise+
plans.notes: Custom quote. Unlimited users, 12-30 private workers. Self-hosted, on-premise, and air-gapped deployment options. 24/7 escalation, named TAM available.

enrichment.provenance: Pricing from spacelift.io/pricing; compliance from spacelift.io/security, which explicitly states SOC 2 Type II and FedRAMP only. HIPAA/GDPR/ISO27001/PCI/CSA-Star are not claimed on the vendor's own page and were removed.

vendors.name: env0
vendors.provenance: Fetched env0.com/pricing on 2026-06-18; docs.envzero.com/guides/billing/subscription-tiers is env0's live docs (docs.env0.com 302-redirects to docs.envzero.com). SOC 2 Type II (2023 report) stated on the pricing page, available on request.

plans.name: Cloud Compass
plans.notes: Flat $1,500/month ($18,000/yr). Up to 100 active environments. Unlimited users, concurrent runs, and cloud resources. IaC coverage tracking, risk assessment, basic drift detection.

plans.name: Cloud Navigator
plans.notes: Custom quote, billed per apply or per active environment. Unlimited active environments. Adds full IaC automation, GitOps workflows, self-service, RBAC, private registry, governance policies.

plans.name: Cloud Pilot
plans.notes: Custom quote, billed per apply or per active environment. All Navigator features plus AI-powered Cloud Analyst, advanced cost management (Infracost), FinOps integrations, observability, advanced drift remediation, Proof-of-Value guarantee.

limits: Cloud Compass capped at 100 active environments
Navigator/Pilot: unlimited environments but custom pricing
keyFeatures: Unlimited concurrent runs on all plans
bestFor: teams wanting unlimited users from day one
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from env0.com/pricing and docs.envzero.com (env0's live docs domain) fetched 2026-06-18; SOC 2 Type II (2023 audit) stated on pricing page, report available on request. No forever-free tier (free trial only).

vendors.name: Scalr
vendors.provenance: Fetched scalr.com/pricing and docs.scalr.io/docs/pricing-faq on 2026-06-18. Current pricing page shows only two named tiers: 'Business' (free, 50 runs/mo) and 'Enterprise' (custom). The draft's separate paid Business tier at $99/mo for 100 prepaid runs is NOT on the current page and was removed. Annual paid consumption tiers exist on AWS Marketplace (prodview-6mlcdsurh25r2) as add-on usage. Public compliance announcement is SOC 2 Type I.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Free tier: 50 runs/month at no cost, 2 concurrent runs. Unlimited users, workspaces, environments, self-hosted agents. All core features included. Drift detection runs not counted. Overage / additional runs charged at the $0.99 flex run rate. Annual prepaid run bundles available via AWS Marketplace (e.g. 6,000 runs/$5,469yr, 8,400 runs/$7,591yr, 12,000 runs/$10,746yr).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom quote. Minimum ~20,000 runs/year. Adds data residency, customer-managed encryption keys, SCIM, advanced audit logs, dedicated support. 10 concurrent managed runs.

limits: No charges for users, workspaces, resources, or private agents
keyFeatures: Pure per-run billing (no seat or resource fees)
Drift detection runs excluded from billing
Unlimited self-hosted agents at no extra cost
bestFor: large teams wanting no per-seat fees
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from scalr.com/pricing (free 'Business' tier + custom Enterprise) and AWS Marketplace annual run bundles, fetched 2026-06-18. The draft's standalone paid $99/mo Business tier is not on the current page and was removed. SOC 2 Type I confirmed via scalr.com/blog/soc-2-type-1; a public SOC 2 Type II completion is not confirmed.

vendors.name: Terrateam
vendors.provenance: Fetched terrateam.io/pricing on 2026-06-18; compliance from terrateam.io/security, which states SOC 2 Type II is in progress (not yet certified).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Unlimited users, runs, concurrency, and private runners. Pull-request automation for Terraform, monorepo execution, concurrent plans, custom workflows, OPA/Conftest policy testing, community support.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $224/month (save 10% annually = ~$201.60/mo billed annually). 30-day free trial. Adds scheduled drift detection, programmatic config generation, customer-owned plan storage, apply requirements, email support, 90-day audit log retention.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $563/month (technical support only) or $1,087.50/month with procurement support. 30-day free trial. Adds API access, CODEOWNERS integration, RBAC, Gatekeeper approvals, centralized org-wide config, 365-day audit log retention, Slack Connect. Non-profits receive 50% discount.

plans.name: OSS Self-Hosted
plans.notes: $0/year. Core workflows only. Self-hosted open-source edition.

plans.name: Paid Self-Hosted
plans.notes: $13,050/year (=$1,087.50/mo equivalent). Self-hosted with governance controls. Adds RBAC, CODEOWNERS, Gatekeeper approvals, 365-day audit retention.

limits: SOC 2 Type II in progress (not yet certified)
keyFeatures: Unlimited users/runs/concurrency on all plans including Free
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from terrateam.io/pricing fetched 2026-06-18; SOC 2 Type II noted as in-progress on terrateam.io/security, not yet certified, so soc2 is null.

vendors.name: Terramate
vendors.provenance: Fetched terramate.io/pricing on 2026-06-18; compliance page references data-center ISO 27001 only. Terramate does not explicitly claim its own SOC 2, ISO 27001, or GDPR certification, so all are null.

plans.name: Community
plans.notes: Forever free. Up to 2 users, up to 1,000 managed resources, 30-day data retention. Includes code management, deployment workflows, PR previews, drift management, observability, SSO. Community Discord support.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: $449/month. 14-day free trial. Unlimited users, up to 5,000 managed resources, 90-day data retention. Adds asset management, policies, CIS benchmarks, DORA metrics, incident management. 24-hour support response via email, chat, Slack.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. PoC trial program. Unlimited users, custom resource limits, custom data retention. Adds SAML 2.0 SSO, RBAC, audit trails, private VCS support, cloud or on-premises deployment. 4-hour SLA, dedicated account manager.

limits: Community: 2 users max, 1,000 resources max, 30-day retention
bestFor: teams using Terramate CLI open source
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from terramate.io/pricing fetched 2026-06-18; compliance page states data-center ISO 27001 only; Terramate's own SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / GDPR certifications are not explicitly claimed, so all compliance fields are null.

vendors.name: HCP Terraform (HashiCorp)
vendors.provenance: Fetched hashicorp.com/products/terraform/pricing on 2026-06-18; legacy free plan EOL March 31, 2026 and 500-resource PAYG free allowance confirmed. Per-resource prices are published starting rates; total cost depends on resource count, so per-plan monthlyUsd is null.

plans.name: Free (PAYG allowance)
plans.notes: Pay-as-you-go model with a free allowance of 500 managed resources. The legacy perpetual free plan was discontinued March 31, 2026. $500 HCP platform credit available to new users. Unlimited users; one concurrent run.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: $0.10/month per managed resource ($0.00013/hour) — usage-based, total depends on resource count so monthlyUsd is null. Includes remote state storage, VCS connection, projects, secure variables, remote runs, private registry (10 modules). No minimum commitment on PAYG.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $0.47/month per managed resource ($0.00064/hour) — usage-based, total depends on resource count so monthlyUsd is null. Adds unlimited module publishing, module deprecation, team notifications, no-code provisioning, HCP Waypoint templates.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $0.99/month per managed resource ($0.00135/hour) — usage-based, total depends on resource count so monthlyUsd is null. Adds module revocation, HCP Waypoint actions, generated module tests (beta).

plans.name: Enterprise (Self-Managed)
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Terraform Enterprise for self-managed deployments. Includes premium support, cross-organization registry sharing. Contact sales.

keyFeatures: Integrated with full HCP platform (Vault, Packer, Consul)
Multi-year Flex plans available via sales
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from hashicorp.com/products/terraform/pricing fetched 2026-06-18; per-resource prices ($0.10/$0.47/$0.99 per resource/mo) are published starting rates with monthlyUsd null because totals are usage-dependent; legacy free tier EOL March 2026 confirmed. Compliance not asserted (left null).

vendors.name: Digger (OpenTaco)
vendors.provenance: Fetched digger.dev and github.com/diggerhq/digger on 2026-06-18; Digger rebranded to OpenTaco on 2025-11-07; community edition is MIT-licensed open source; digger.dev/pricing returns 404 and no public commercial price exists, so the enterprise price is null and the prior unverified $3,000-$5,000/mo figure was removed.

plans.name: Community (Open Source)
plans.notes: MIT-licensed. Fully self-hosted. Runs Terraform/OpenTofu natively inside your existing CI (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI). PR automation, drift detection, state management. No vendor compute costs.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Commercial license. No public pricing page as of June 2026 (digger.dev/pricing returns 404). Contact sales for quote. Adds enterprise governance, RBAC, audit logs, dedicated support.

limits: Community edition is fully self-hosted; no managed backend provided
Enterprise pricing not publicly listed (no pricing page)
keyFeatures: Runs Terraform inside your own CI (no third-party compute)
enrichment.provenance: Community edition confirmed MIT open source via github.com/diggerhq/digger (which also displays the OpenTaco rebrand notice dated 2025-11-07); digger.dev/pricing returns 404, no public enterprise pricing, so monthlyUsd is null and the 2023-era $3,000-$5,000/mo figure was removed as unverified.
